title: Remove ASAP/10min/15min/Today timing options and Live Location Tracking from booking form

requirements.text: In BookingFormSection.tsx and BookingPage.tsx, remove the following options from the Service Timing dropdown: 'ASAP', 'Within 10 minutes', 'Within 15 MINUTES', and 'Today'. Keep only 'Within 30 minutes' and 'Within 1 hour' as valid options. Do not change any other form fields, layout, styling, animations, or functionality.

quotes: Within 10 minutes aur within 15 minutes Aur ASAP aur today wala hata do
Timing dropdown se hatayen: ASAP, Within 10 minutes, Within 15 MINUTES, Today
Rahene den: Within 30 minutes, Within 1 hour

acceptanceCriteria: The timing dropdown in the booking form contains exactly two options: 'Within 30 minutes' and 'Within 1 hour'
Options 'ASAP', 'Within 10 minutes', 'Within 15 MINUTES', and 'Today' are no longer present in the dropdown
All other form fields (name, phone, email, address, service, etc.) remain unchanged
Form layout, styling, and animations are unchanged

requirements.text: In BookingFormSection.tsx and BookingPage.tsx, remove the Live Location Tracking section/feature entirely from the booking form UI. The address input field must remain so users can manually type their address. Do not remove the IP-based auto-fill functionality for the address field (ipapi.co). Do not change any other form fields, layout, styling, animations, or functionality.

quotes: live location tracking wala bhi hata do
form address wala option rahene dena user address daal sake

acceptanceCriteria: No 'Live Location Tracking' button, map, or live GPS tracking UI element is visible in the booking form
The address text input field is still present and editable by the user
IP-based address auto-fill (city, region, country from ipapi.co) still works if previously implemented
Hidden latitude/longitude fields remain if previously added
Form layout, styling, and animations are unchanged

constraints: Do not change any other section or page of the website
Do not remove the address input field from the booking form
Do not alter form layout, styling, or animations
Do not modify the FormSubmit action URL or any other hidden fields
Do not change IP-based address auto-fill functionality
nonGoals: Changes to any page other than the booking form
Modifying service options or other dropdowns
Changing SEO content, meta tags, or structured data
